title: Enforcement Clawback on the Parking License Storage Bundle Rate
content:
Community parking rules: violation fines billed on a Parking License claw back part of its storage bundle discount rate.

## Rule

When two or more fines were billed on the license in the 12 months before the handling date, the enforcement clawback is 0.04; when exactly one fine was billed on the license in those months, the enforcement clawback is 0.02; in every other case there is no enforcement clawback. The enforcement clawback is subtracted from the bundle rate, and the bundle rate is never below zero.

## Clawback by fines billed

| Fines billed on the license in the 12 months before the handling date | Enforcement clawback |
|---|---|
| two or more | 0.04 (4 points) |
| exactly one | 0.02 (2 points) |
| none | none |

Warnings and tows without a fine line are not fines billed on the license.

## Illustrations (hypothetical rates)

- A bundle rate of 0.10 on a license with one fine in the 12 months: 0.10 less 0.02, that is 0.08.
- A bundle rate of 0.03 on a license with three fines: 0.03 less 0.04 would fall below zero, so the bundle rate is 0.
